_doc: Terrain skyline by bearing (deg true), 0.5 deg steps, 180-335: [bearing, altitude_deg above horizontal, distance_m of the skyline-forming cell, its elevation_m], and every named peak from every site (bearing and distance to the DEM summit inside the box; blocked_below = the highest ground on that bearing up to 2.5 km short of it, with where it is; beyond_2km repeats that ignoring ground nearer than 2 km, so a bank beside the site does not decide a peak). Eye 1.2 m over the DEM ground; curvature with refraction k=0.13; rays to 112 km. DEM: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second (about 10 m cells, bare earth, NAVD88), the staged 1 x 1 degree tiles listed under "dem". Script: horizon_3dep.py beside this file. The plan-grade study it replaces: horizon.plan-grade.json.
